capabilities: Display a filled banner on agent-authored notes in reading and editing views
Show accent-colored dots next to tagged files in the file explorer
Add or remove agent-authored tags via command-palette commands that edit file properties only
Toggle the banner and explorer indicators independently in settings
extras: Not listed in the community plugin directory; must be built from source and copied into the plugins folder manually. Requires Obsidian 1.8.7+. Makes no network requests or telemetry. It relies on explicit tags, not AI detection, so notes are only marked when the user tags them.
problem: Obsidian gives no visual way to tell which notes were written by AI agents versus by the user.
summary: Marks agent-authored notes with a banner and file-explorer dots based on explicit tags the user adds.
